scope: 18 actual native PNGs: six selected iPhone17Pro scenes in English/German/Arabic. Read-only visual review; no implementation or publication.

findings.description: Raw Arabic quest counter visibly presents left-to-right glyph sequence6/3, although the captured scene has3 locked strings out of6 and English counterpart shows3/6. Source fraction helper concatenates localized done, thin-space slash and total without numeric direction isolation; TuneView describes the counter as3of6.
findings.remaining_action: Verify intended compact numeric reading and constrain/isolate only the fraction run so done/total stays3/6 while the surrounding quest row remains RTL; rerun actual Arabic capture. Do not change physical musical rail order.

visual_observations: No additional convincing frame-edge clipping, text/control overlap or missing-glyph boxes found in the18 reviewed standard-size images. Suspected tight areas were checked against raw PNGs/crops rather than inferred from contact-sheet edges.
German long strum headline, instrument family, chord header, reminder, coach recommendation and results buttons wrap or fit without losing text.

Arabic letter joining and RTL controls/grid/title alignment are visually coherent in these scenes; Latin pitch/octave/chord runs and physical six-string/highway order remain readable LTR. This is bounded visual inspection, not native-speaker grammar certification.
English song lyric lines remain visible in localized performance scenes. Their semantic translation policy and musical-content wording are not certified by this visual review.

Truthful visible states include locked tuner string, partial strum diagnosis, all-six-string chord completion, three-star violin result and combo-bearing chorus performance. Static images alone do not prove duration, audio, interaction or synchronization.

inspection_method.contact_sheets: Three QA-ONLY six-frame sheets generated from original PNGs for comparative inspection. Tool display downsized sheets; direct original results/performance images and native-pixel crops of Arabic quest/header and German strum were additionally examined.
inspection_method.provenance_check: All18 named PNG byte contents independently matched raw exported attachments using named/index.json IDs. Each is1206x2622; no original overwritten.
inspection_method.derived_QA_only: Contact sheets/crops are outside git and are not deliverables or replacement media.

limits: Only six selected scenes per language, including violin results. This is not complete nine-frame main iPhone listing, any iPad set, all49 app-language matrix or all50 listing locales.
Hosted job success is parent-provided context; this reviewer inspected downloaded media/index bytes rather than independently retrieving run state.
No universal linguistic/semantic, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type/AX5, contrast-ratio, hit-target, animation, audio or physical-device certification.
AR-RATIO-01 is a raw-image numeric-order finding; proposed implementation must preserve accessibility spoken done-of-total semantics and surrounding RTL.
No source changed and no media published. Only this review receipt and explicitly labeled QA derivatives outside git created.
